Claim: Typed-core optic-lobe cell-type channels show a structured history-ambiguity hierarchy
Evidence: Typed-core graph: 53,987 typed body-ID rows, 6,503,309 typed-core edges, total synapse weight 26,658,583; full typed-core H(src_type|dst_type)=4.381 bits, MI=2.993 bits, effective preimage size=20.839; ROI values differ across ME(R), LO(R), LOP(R), and OL(R); hierarchy persists qualitatively under family-merge, coarse visual class, alpha-prefix, and weighted type-community taxonomies
Null/control: Typed-core filtering; ROI/pathway stratification; taxonomy sensitivity analysis
Caveat: Anatomical/statistical proxy; body-ID rows are treated as segments unless independently verified; typed-core filter may bias channel statistics; no activity or heat measurement

Claim: Known visual pathway groups show ordered cell-type history ambiguity consistent with optic-lobe organization
Evidence: Curated hierarchy: lamina input 1.417 bits, medulla intrinsic 3.960 bits, T4/T5/direct partners 4.294 bits, output/projection 4.628 bits; directional stages include lamina->medulla 0.768 bits and medulla->lobula plate 2.210 bits. Authoritative channel table reports uncertainty intervals for each filter.
Main metric: H(src_type|dst_type) by curated and directional pathway
Null/control: Degree-preserving nulls and type-label permutation nulls; observed ambiguity is lower than matched null means across reported known-pathway groups
Caveat: Some large groups used reproducible 1M-edge sampling for nulls; pathway definitions are curated type-name/ROI proxies; available null ensemble p-values do not survive global BH/FDR correction across all null tests

Evidence: Rescue sweep at 1500 nodes / 12000 edges: local-Hebbian real accuracy 0.649 with delta MI 1.113 bits; readout-only real accuracy 0.652 with delta MI 1.120 bits. Reviewer held-out controls show real and degree-preserving nulls are indistinguishable for linear/ReLU features under type-structured templates and source-type permutation eliminates real-vs-null advantages.
Main metric: Motion-direction accuracy and predicted-label task MI in synthetic four-class task
Null/control: Degree-preserving null, weight-shuffled fixed topology, uniform-weight fixed topology, template-permutation controls, feature controls, and readout-only controls
Supported?: Yes for generic separability; No for real-specific synaptic proof; No for plasticity-specific learning
Caveat: Original rescue/final-control runs report in-sample readout performance; representation-probe rule search uses a held-out split; synthetic type-structured inputs can inflate separability; detailed real weights are not uniquely supported

Claim: Local plasticity and rule search do not improve beyond readout-only
Evidence: Final control: local-Hebbian minus readout-only delta accuracy=-0.00254 and delta MI=-0.00633; rule-search representation-probe plasticity_delta_MI=0 for all tested local and ambiguity-gated rules; best discovery candidate was no_plasticity
Main metric: Plasticity delta MI and plasticity delta accuracy relative to readout-only
Null/control: Hebbian, reward-Hebbian, Oja, reward-Oja, BCM, reward-BCM, ambiguity-gated Hebbian/Oja, energy-normalized ambiguity-gated Oja, symbolic sparse rules
Caveat: Negative result applies to this synthetic task, one-step message-passing model, local update rules, and tested search space

Claim: Landauer/physical learning-rate framing remains a motivating analogy only
